exposure: high ratio of soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 (sFlt1) and placental growth factor (PlGF) in an index pregnancy
outcome: Ischemic placental disease (IPD) in a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: The study included 109 patients who underwent evaluation for preeclampsia, had angiogenic factors measured in an index pregnancy with IPD, and experienced a subsequent pregnancy at the same institution.
finding: A high sFlt1/PlGF ratio in an index pregnancy is not associated with a higher risk of Ischemic Placental Disease (IPD) in a subsequent pregnancy.
